messages.content: Help me validate user input in a form field with the ID 'userInputField' after the user has finished typing?

function.name: validateUserInput
function.description: This function is called after a user has finished typing in a form field, to validate the input provided. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

inputField.description: The form field whose input needs to be validated. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

isComplete.description: Indicates if the user has finished typing in the input field. This is JavaScript Boolean type parameter in string representation.
